      Taylor wears I ❤️ NY Balm Dotcom.
      Chris wears I ❤️ NY Balm Dotcom + Lip Line in Bit.

      A hydrating lip balm packed with antioxidants + natural emollients to nourish dry, chafed skin.

      A plant-based oil with fatty acids and unique water-binding properties to help keep lips moisturized.

      A naturally-derived emollient that leaves lips feeling cushiony and non-sticky.

      A conditioning oil that nourishes and moisturizes the lips, while providing a unique formula texture and barrier to help prevent dryness.

      An antioxidant blend of Vitamin E, Rice Bran and Rosemary Extracts to help combat free-radical damage and support and maintain the integrity of delicate lips.

      Balm Dotcom ingredients

      Clinically proven to moisturize lips for up to 12 hours

      • 100% agreed that lips feel soothed from dryness + look replenished*
      • 100% agreed that lips look + feel intensely moisturized*
      • 100% agreed lips look soft + supple*
      • 94% agreed lips feel like they are wrapped in moisture*

      Apply to lips wherever and whenever you need an extra dose of moisture.

      1. Squeeze a small amount directly to dry, chapped lips or your fingertip.
      2. Reapply throughout the day if you need extra hydration, or you know, you just miss us.
      3. While you’re at it, apply Original to cuticles, elbows, or wherever else could use some moisture. Lips shouldn’t get to have all the fun!
